scenario: 今天的个性化赛道只有一篇，来自快手电商的全屏推荐流。它讲了沉浸式信息流里两个容易被忽略的问题：用户买完就走，会让会不会继续下划这个目标误伤成交；每一屏只顾眼前最优，又会拖累后面几屏的整体收益。作者从样本标签和多屏联合排序两头入手，并给出了线上 A/B 结果。

papers.title: STCRank: Spatio-temporal Collaborative Ranking for Interactive Recommender System at Kuaishou E-shop
papers.authors: Boyang Xia, Ruilin Bao, Hanjun Jiang, Jun Wang, Wenwu Ou
papers.abstract: As a popular e-commerce platform, Kuaishou E-shop provides precise personalized product recommendations to tens of millions of users every day. To better respond real-time user feedback, we have deployed an interactive recommender system (IRS) alongside our core homepage recommender system. This IRS \footnotemark is triggered by user click on homepage, and generates a series of highly relevant recommendations based on the clicked item to meet focused browsing demands. Different from traditional e-commerce RecSys, the full-screen UI and immersive swiping down functionality present two distinct challenges for regular ranking system. First, there exists explicit interference (overlap or conflicts) between ranking objectives, i.e., conversion, view and swipe down. This is because there are intrinsic behavioral co-occurrences under the premise of immersive browsing and swiping down functionality. Second, the ranking system is prone to temporal greedy traps in sequential recommendation slot transitions, which is caused by full-screen UI design. To alleviate these challenges, we propose a novel Spatio-temporal collaborative ranking (STCRank) framework to achieve collaboration between multi-objectives within one slot (spatial) and between multiple sequential recommondation slots. In multi-objective collaboration (MOC) module, we push Pareto frontier by mitigating the objective overlaps and conflicts. In multi-slot collaboration (MSC) module, we achieve global optima on overall sequential slots by dual-stage look-ahead ranking mechanism. Extensive experiments demonstrate our proposed method brings about purchase and DAU co-growth. The proposed system has been already deployed at Kuaishou E-shop since 2025.6.

papers.summary: 在全屏、往下划就换下一件的电商推荐流里，会不会买和会不会继续往下划这两个排序目标会互相打架。快手电商的数据显示，用户下单后 61.3% 的情况会直接离开，不再往下划。按常规方式打标签，这些成交样本在下划目标里全成了负样本，模型学到的下划分数反过来压低了好卖的商品。作者把下单后离开的样本从下划目标的负样本里剔除。排序也不再逐屏挑当前分最高的商品，而是给接下来几件商品的不同排列打分：每件商品的价值乘上用户还会划到它的概率，加总后选总分最高的排列。只在全屏流里加上这种往后看的排序，线上购买就涨了 2.10%。做沉浸式信息流的团队，值得先查一遍多个目标之间的标签冲突。
